title: Episode 1 – The Station That Doesn't Exist

scenes.image_prompt: Empty Japanese commuter train at night, swaying hand straps, flickering lights, black windows
scenes.narration: It's 11:40 PM. I fell asleep on the last train.
scenes.telop: Never get off at this station.

scenes.image_prompt: protagonist waking up alone, staring at a pitch-black window
scenes.narration: When I woke up, the train was empty. And the windows showed nothing.

scenes.image_prompt: Abandoned rural station, blank wooden sign, single lamp, thick fog, dark forest
scenes.narration: The train stopped at a station I'd never heard of.

scenes.image_prompt: Tall figure in old station uniform at end of foggy platform, face in shadow, beckoning
scenes.narration: Someone was waiting. And it was waving at me.

scenes.image_prompt: protagonist at the open train door, hesitating, warm train light vs cold blue fog
scenes.narration: The doors are open. What should I do?
Comment A or B. Your choice decides what happens next.

caption:
I fell asleep on the last train and woke up at a station that isn't on any map.
Someone in an old uniform was waiting at the end of the platform. Waving.
The doors are open. Would you get off?
Comment A or B 👇

next_episode_hooks.A: XX% chose A. So I stepped off the train — and the doors slammed shut behind me.
next_episode_hooks.B: XX% chose B. I stayed on. Then the figure started walking toward my door.
